label: Compare rankings, fork joins and finite transfer accounting on one actual grounding cone
summary: Local accessibility is equivalent to excluding an arbitrary Nat-indexed upstream walk anchored at the selected actual recipient. Using injective regress denial requires acyclicity of its complete cone. A one-step join and a finite source path give a Nat rank on the cone. An acyclic split into two leaves separates numerical descent from one-step joining, and the well-founded Nat-with-top interpretation separates accessibility from Nat ranking. Positive gap, lower bound and uniform edge drop are distinct inputs to the existing numerical route. Finite joining still allows the common-source ray. The selected transfer exit conditions specialize the existing unlocated ledger and receipt premises to events or positive entries following actual grounds with a mark into the selected bearer. These yield two conditional source-path routes. The same contingent recipient in the common-source ray witnesses both sufficient accounting bundles and an injective regress. Two explicit edge inclusions specialize cone well-foundedness to the Second and Third Way relations on the cone carrier. See docs/notes/contractive-borrowed-power-1378.md for the comparison, current provisional assessment and rival tests.
blocker: Independent evidence for existential edge alignment, the receipt or throughput coverage law, and actual one-step joining or a warranted rank remains open. Derivative productive provenance supports a candidate source commitment. Spreading it across the full cone or transporting it to caused necessity requires separately justified edges and coverage.

current_assessment.scope: One actual concrete recipient, its complete grounding cone, and finite provenance in a fixed productive respect.
current_assessment.assessment: Anchored unrestricted-walk denial is exact for cone well-foundedness. One-step joins and a finite source path imply Nat rank. Aligned receipt or throughput coverage gives a source path and can coexist with an infinite branch. The instrumental examples give prima facie warrant to finite productive provenance for exhaustively derivative exercise. The source-free alternative can supply each member conditionally and still owes an independent account of why its actual activity is positive. The same activation test applies to an underived source posited by a rival. Existential applicability, full-cone foundation and transport to caused necessity remain open.
current_assessment.next_test: Identify an independently specified actual existential transfer class and a coverage law, or justify a same-respect productive rule that selects positive activity in a source-free cone. Test the same effect and recipient under each account.
current_assessment.evidence: Draft PR #2030. Focused binding, Comparator and NanoDa checked the formal delivery locally. The independent semantic challenge is pending.
